## What problem does this solve?
A clear description of the problem or gap this feature addresses.

## Proposed Solution
Describe what you'd like to see added or changed.

## Detection / Use Case (if applicable)
If this is a new threat detection, describe:
- What attacker behavior it detects
- What data source / signal it uses
- Any known false-positive risks

## Alternatives Considered
Any other approaches you've considered.

## Additional Context
Links, references, or screenshots if relevant.
